response.justification: While Bogdan exceeds the educational requirement (Bachelor's degree + 16 years of professional experience) and demonstrates strong general software engineering capabilities, he lacks the specialized expertise essential for this Principal Performance Architect role. His entire career has focused on web/backend/full-stack development rather than hardware performance optimization, AI workload analysis, and SoC/IP modeling. There is no evidence of GPU architecture experience, deep learning optimization expertise, or hardware-software co-design skills critical for optimizing AI accelerators.
strengths: Exceeds educational requirements with Bachelor's degree and 16+ years of progressive senior-level software engineering experience
Demonstrates strong low-latency systems optimization skills from Dunnhumby experience handling millions of requests/second with performance-critical infrastructure
Current Staff-level role at re:cinq includes AI-infrastructure exposure and proven system architecture design capabilities across diverse technology stack
concerns: No specialized experience in AI accelerator optimization, GPU architecture, or deep learning workload performance analysis—core requirements for this role
Career trajectory entirely in web/backend/full-stack development rather than hardware performance optimization, SoC modeling, or specialized processor architecture
Missing critical technical competencies: SoC/IP modeling, SIMD/MIMD architecture experience, and hardware-software co-design at the system level

key_factors.factor: Hardware performance architecture and SoC/IP modeling experience
Education level and years of professional experience
